title: 재고 게이트 V2: 물리 연결 + 획득 토큰, rollback 안전 소유권

actions.name: ENTER
actions.gate: NULL only; WAIT_CALC accepts same year/week full-product CALC on another physical session; each acquisition gets NEWID; RUN never reenters or expires

actions.name: LEAVE
actions.gate: compare Mode=RUN, Action, OwnerSessionID=@@SPID and caller-local OwnerToken; a stale/missing token changes zero rows

actions.name: CALC_FAILURE
actions.gate: matching acquired owner retains WAIT_CALC; an outer rollback may restore an earlier owner/token, which Leave must preserve

actions.name: LEGACY_CLEAR
actions.gate: no-argument global Clear raises STOCK_GATE_UNSAFE_CLEAR_DISABLED; old raw clear violates the V2 state CHECK; explicit same-outer-transaction deferred clear uses stockGateOperation helper and verifies native success, original transaction marker, SPID, acquisition token and year/week/action, then requires one changed row

actions.name: CAPABILITY
actions.gate: read-only ProtocolVersion=2 and IsReady=1; verifies six module hashes, owner column types/nullability, and the trusted/enabled state constraint definition hash

sideEffects.NenovaStockWeekGate: add OwnerSessionID, OwnerToken, PendingCalc, CalcProdKey, ProtocolVersion and a validated state CHECK; no ledger rows
sideEffects.storedProcedures: replace gate helpers; modify only gate declarations/call arguments inside the three native procedures; external native parameters and business SQL preserved
sideEffects.ShipmentMaster/ShipmentDetail/ShipmentDa: no writes from the gate migration or helpers
sideEffects.Product.Stock/StockHistory/ProductStock/: no writes from the gate migration or helpers; native business formulas unchanged

compatibility.sqlServer: SQL Server 2016 SP1+; production 13.0.7095.1; isolated SQL2022 tests run compatibility_level=130
compatibility.nativeSignatures: usp_ShipmentFix, usp_ShipmentFixCancel and usp_StockCalculation unchanged for EXE callers
compatibility.helperProtocol: GateEnter requires @ProtocolVersion=2 and returns @OwnerToken; CALC supplies @CalcProdKey; GateLeave receives the token in a SQL local variable surviving rollback
compatibility.legacyCutover: Before migration, main must update every legacy skipStockCalc/no-argument Clear/raw gate-clear path to lib/stockGateOperation.js. Normal legacy fix/unfix uses first native CALC @ProdKey=0, including categories with <=5 products. Deferred skipStockCalc uses lockStockGateOperation before lease/business locks and clearStockGateOperation after native success, within the same still-live outer transaction. Do not fetch/clear through a pooled separate query. Owned deferred clear proves ownership only, not final inventory consistency; caller retains final-calculation/recovery responsibility.
compatibility.legacyV1Bridge: New API may be deployed before migration. Helper recognizes V1 only when all five owner columns AND the capability procedure are absent; partial/malformed V2 never falls back. V1 keeps initial idle row lock and same-transaction/scope clear but cannot fix the native post-rollback unconditional Leave defect. New existing-quantity feature remains disabled until V2 capability passes. No V1 bridge may be presented as V2 concurrency safety.
compatibility.legacyHelper: lockStockGateOperation(tQ,types,{orderYear,orderWeek,action:'FIX'|'CANCEL',requireV2:false}) -> immutable context; clearStockGateOperation(tQ,types,context,{nativeResult:0,nativeReturnCode:0}) -> cleared. Both native outputs are mandatory numeric zero; NULL/missing values never mean success. Helpers never own/commit transactions. A unique transaction-owned sp_getapplock marker only proves transaction identity after a rollback/rebegin on reused SPID; EXE serialization is provided by the real gate row, not the marker.
compatibility.backend: Before any new quantity write require capability ProtocolVersion=2/IsReady=1. Inside the same physical SQL transaction, acquire GateKey=1 UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK only in fully idle NULL state before data locks; retain it through all product-scoped native calculations, result verification and baseline advance. No pool query or per-product commit. Require explicit SP return code=0 AND output result=0 AND original transaction health; missing/NULL results are not success. Any failure aborts the whole request.
compatibility.sameSession: A second Enter while RUN is rejected even on the owning SPID. Token reuse/reentrant RUN is not supported.
compatibility.pendingHandoff: Legacy FIX/CANCEL pending scope is conservatively the full year/week. Only CALC with the exact year/week and @CalcProdKey=0 may consume it. New atomic quantity writes start from idle and can call product-scoped CALC while retaining the outer row lock.
compatibility.staleWait: WAIT_CALC is not a lease timeout. A new EXE connection may recover it by the ordinary same-year/week full-product stock calculation. Failed calculation retains pending work.
compatibility.orphanRun: No automatic RUN/WAIT_CALC time reclamation, including a missing/sleeping/dead session. Main must drain writers, determine committed/rolled-back state and arrange an explicit scope-preserving recovery. Session death alone does not prove the native commit did not happen.
compatibility.rollout: 1) Deploy API V1/V2 bridge with ALL ownerless clear paths removed and new quantity feature V2-gated/disabled. 2) Enter maintenance and drain ALL EXE/web/jobs; main verifies current inactive/idle singleton immediately before migration. 3) Apply owner migration atomically with main acknowledgement; verify V2 capability and legacy full-CALC/deferred-clear paths. 4) Only then enable new quantity route and release maintenance. If drain cannot be guaranteed, withhold migration/deployment activation and report blocker. Never activate new writes through a capability-missing temporary fallback. Application rollback must keep the bridge or disable affected routes; do not run the old gate installer. No runtime DDL or permission grants.
compatibility.noMigrationAlternative: An application-only outer transaction/savepoint/advisory lock cannot prevent the old native post-rollback unconditional Leave or queued global Clear. Keep the new physical-quantity route disabled until the gate and caller cutover pass isolated SQL tests. A fully drained maintenance operation is not an online replacement.

crossYearFixture.description: WAIT_CALC for 2026/34-02 cannot be consumed by CALC for 2025/34-02 or 2026/34-01; same-year/week different-session full CALC can recover it. No business data are used.

testBoundary: Default test is offline. --sql accepts explicit JSON from stdin only; fixed loopback:14339, dedicated NenovaStockGateOwnerFixture database, fixtureOnly=true. Never imports app db/auth/env loaders. SQL integration is mandatory before deployment; offline tests do not establish SQL concurrency correctness.
integrationOwner: Main owns package/CI registration and API wiring; package.json and application files are outside this subtask's write scope. Main has registered the offline test under test:estimate-edit-safety. SQL --sql remains an explicit isolated-fixture gate, not an application startup action.
